overview: A dark-mode personal finance tracker for mobile that records income and expenses by category, shows the available balance, and charts where the most money was spent.
features: Register income and expenses with amount, category, date and note
Predefined categories including Comida, Transporte and Entretenimiento
Available balance summary with income and expense totals
Horizontal bar chart and progress bar highlighting the top spending category
Recent movements list with period and type filters
Dark interface with green and grey tones, responsive on mobile
